questions.stem: There are 3 consecutive odd numbers and 3 consecutive even numbers. The smallest even number is 9 more than largest odd number. If the square of average of all the 3 given odd number is 507 less than the square of the average of all the 3 given even number, what is the smallest odd number.
questions.explanation: Let a consecutive odd numbers = 𝑥 – 2, 𝑥 and 𝑥+ 2 and consecutive even numbers = 𝑦 – 2, 𝑦, 𝑦+ 2 So, 𝑦 – 2 = 9 + 𝑥 + 2 𝑦 – 𝑥 = 13 … (i) and (𝑥)2 + 507 = (𝑦)2 𝑦2 −𝑥2 = 507 (𝑥+ 𝑦)(𝑦−𝑥) = 507 (𝑥+ 𝑦) = 13 ⇒𝑥+ 𝑦= 39 … (𝑖) Solving (i) and (ii) 𝑦 = 26 and 𝑥 = 13 so smallest odd numbers = 𝑥 – 2 = 13 – 2 = 11
